$comment: Phase 6 sound effects (ByteDance Seed Audio on OpenRouter). Run: OPEN_ROUTER_KEY=... pnpm --filter @civolution/assets sounds -- --manifest manifests/phase6-sounds.json. Every prompt starts with 'The sound of' (the tool adds it when missing).

items.prompt: The sound of a bright brass fanfare rising over a festive crowd cheering and bells ringing, triumphant and warm, without voices singing words, about three seconds
The sound of a city gate creaking open while a distant crowd cheers and a drum beats a slow welcome, without voices speaking words, about two and a half seconds
The sound of a huge rocket engine igniting with a deep rumbling roar that builds and fades into the sky, without voices, about four seconds
The sound of a hot dry wind sweeping over cracked earth with a low ominous drone underneath, without voices, about three seconds
The sound of a wooden gavel striking twice in a large echoing hall, followed by polite applause from a crowd, without voices speaking words, about two and a half seconds
The sound of a factory steam whistle followed by a low hiss of smoke from chimneys, without voices, about two seconds
The sound of an angry crowd murmuring and stamping in a stone square, with a few shouts that are not words, about two seconds
The sound of a deep electrical hum rising into a warning siren and a heavy muffled boom, without voices, about three seconds
The sound of a grand orchestral fanfare with trumpets and timpani building to a triumphant final chord, without voices, about five seconds
The sound of a slow mournful horn over a low drum roll fading into silence, without voices, about four seconds
